abn.description: The contractor's Australian Business Number — the registration's identity coordinate (`contractor_abn` on the fact; `abn` in the payload).

classification.description: The grade/level held under that scheme.

entity_name.description: The registered entity's trading/legal name, when the classifier file carries it.

observed_at.description: When the registration was observed; the gate requires it and the router derives it from `registered_at`, falling back to the harvest time.

region_code.description: The jurisdiction the scheme belongs to, derived from `scheme`; unmapped schemes log and leave it NULL (`:609-613`), and the partition bucket falls back to `OTHER`.

registered_at.description: When the registration took effect; also the preferred `observed_at`.

scheme.description: The prequalification scheme the registration is under, e.g. one of `tfnsw_r_levels`, `nsw_construction`, `vic_csr`, `qld_tmr`, `federal_npp`.

source_dataset.description: Producer identity; the atom's `source_system` lowercased — `"classifier_repo"` as written today.

status.description: The registration's state; parser defaults `"active"` when the source omits it. The tenant projector consumes **only** `"active"` rows, so a wrong default silently changes what tenants see.
